title: Communication Dated 16.4.36 From The Netherlands Consulate-General Concerning Miss Marina A. Shkliarevich

ZOZ-C
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 2, Special Branch
REPORT
（印：File No. KLG.S11Y / D. 736 / Station //）
Date April 25, 36

Subject Communication dated 16.4.36 from the Netherlands Consulate-General
concerning Miss Marina A. Shkliarevich.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev Forwarded by D S I (cy)

Enquiries show that Miss Marina Anatolievna SHKLIAREVICH,
is a Russian who was born on March 20, 1918 at Vladivostock.
She arrived in Shanghai from Harbin on May 13, 1934 in the
s.s. "Dairen Maru" together with her mother, Mrs. Helene V.
Shkliarevich, a divorcee. They travelled on Soviet passport
No. 109555 issued on January 13, 1926, at Vladivostock which
bears endorsements indicating that prior to coming to Shanghai
they resided in Harbin for about eight years.
Some time during 1934 they renounced their Soviet citizen-
ship and registered with the Bureau of Public Safety as Russian
emigrants. On August 7, 1935, when renewing her registration
certificate through the medium of the Council of United Russian
Organizations (SORO) Miss Shkliarevich requested that the new
registration certificate be issued to her in the name of
M. Shkliarevich-Rafeli, stating that she was an artist and that
"Rafeli" was her stage name.
Following her arrival in Shanghai Miss Shkliarevich is
reported to have been employed for a short period in Tkchenko's
Cafe, Avenue Joffre, as a waitress. Towards the end of 1934
she started to work as a dancing partner in local cabarets and
is at present employed in this capacity at the "Casanova"
cabaret, Avenue Edward VII.
Since January 28, 1936, she has been residing at the
Embassy Hotel where she registered under the name M. Rafeli,
artist, and gave her nationality as Italian.
It is rumoured that until very recently she was the
"protégée" of a certain local broker.
Nothing detrimental from either political or moral points
of view is known in this office regarding Miss Shkliarevich.
Officer i/c Special Branch.
A. Prokofiev
D.S.I.

（批：JMR. / 25 4/36）

日期 1936年4月25日

事由：荷兰总领事馆1936年4月16日来函，涉及玛丽娜·A·什克利亚列维奇小姐。

由侦探长普罗科菲耶夫呈报 转呈 侦探长（抄送）

经查，玛丽娜·阿纳托利耶芙娜·什克利亚列维奇小姐，
系俄罗斯人，1918年3月20日出生于符拉迪沃斯托克。
她与其母海伦娜·V·什克利亚列维奇夫人（离异）于1934年5月13日乘“大连丸”号轮船从哈尔滨抵达上海。
她们持用的是1926年1月13日在符拉迪沃斯托克签发的苏联护照，号码为109555，
护照上的批注显示，在来上海之前，她们已在哈尔滨居住约八年。
在1934年的某个时候，她们放弃了苏联国籍，并在公共安全局登记为俄罗斯侨民。
1935年8月7日，什克利亚列维奇小姐通过俄罗斯联合组织委员会（SORO）更新其登记证时，
请求将新登记证以 M. Shkliarevich-Rafeli 之名签发给她，声称她是一名艺人，且“Rafeli”是她的艺名。
据报，什克利亚列维奇小姐抵沪后，曾在霞飞路 Tkchenko 咖啡馆短暂受雇为女服务员。
1934年底，她开始在当地歌舞厅担任舞伴，目前受雇于爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）的“卡萨诺瓦”（Casanova）歌舞厅，担任此职。
自1936年1月28日起，她一直居住在 Embassy Hotel（大使饭店），登记姓名为 M. Rafeli，职业为艺人，并申报国籍为意大利。
有传言称，直到最近她还是某位本地掮客的“被保护人”。
本处关于什克利亚列维奇小姐，在政治或道德方面均未掌握任何不利记录。
特科主管警官。
A. 普罗科菲耶夫
侦探长

（批注：JMR. / 1936年4月25日）

Shanghai Municipal Police,

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR CHINA.
No. 836

SHANGHAI, 16th April 1936.

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that Mary SHKLIAREVICH
has applied to me for a visé for admission into Hungary.
She was born in Vladivostock on the 20th March 1918
and in possession of a passport issued by the Commissioner
of Public Safety in Shanghai on the 8th August 1935, valid
for one year and only for travelling in China.
She is an artist and resides at the Embassy Hotel,
Bubbling Well Road.
Her intention is to visit Hungary in company of Mr.
J.Schneider, a Hungarian subject and to remain abroad for
about 3 months.
I should be much obliged to you if you would let me
know, if possible, whether anything is known against Miss
Shkliarevich from a political or moral point of view.

I have the honour to be,

Sir,

Your obedient servant,

Chinese Secretary,
for Consul General for the Netherlands,
temporarily in charge of
Hungarian Interests.

The Deputy Commissioner,
Special Branch,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.
page_data.zh:
荷兰驻中国总领事馆
编号 836

上海，1936年4月16日。

先生：

谨此告知您，Mary SHKLIAREVICH 已向我申请前往匈牙利的入境签证。
她于1918年3月20日出生于符拉迪沃斯托克，
持有上海公共安全局总监于1935年8月8日签发的护照，有效期一年，仅限在中国境内旅行使用。
她是一名艺人，现居住于静安寺路（Bubbling Well Road）的 Embassy Hotel（大使饭店）。
她打算与匈牙利籍人士 J. Schneider 先生一同前往匈牙利，并在国外停留约三个月。
如蒙告知是否掌握任何针对 Shkliarevich 小姐的政治或道德方面的不利情况，我将不胜感激。

谨致，

先生，

您顺从的仆人，

华务秘书，
代荷兰总领事，
暂管匈牙利利益事务。

副总监，
特科，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海。
